title: MinHash & Jaccard Similarity
interviewAnswer: MinHash creates compact signatures whose collision probability equals Jaccard similarity, allowing approximate set similarity at scale.
why: MinHash is foundational for web-scale duplicate detection and sparse-set similarity.
intuition: Keep a small randomized signature instead of repeatedly intersecting huge sets.
deepDive: Under a random permutation, the probability that two sets share the same minimum element equals their Jaccard similarity.
commonMistakes: Using it for arbitrary Euclidean distance.
followUps: How does MinHash connect to LSH?
production: Choose signature size by memory/accuracy requirements and validate candidate recall.
workedExample: Document shingles can use MinHash to detect near-duplicate pages.
